crew.overview: After Dr. Bill Harford's wife, Alice, admits to having sexual fantasies about a man she met, Bill becomes obsessed with having a sexual encounter. He discovers an underground sexual group and attends one of their meetings -- and quickly discovers that he is in over his head.
crew.title: Eyes Wide Shut

details.biography:
Malik Hassan Sayeed is an American cinematographer, producer and director.

He is known for his work on films directed by Spike Lee, as well as  Hype Williams' film Belly (1998). Sayeed has also contributed to music videos, including Lauryn Hill's "Ex-Factor", Kanye West's "Gold Digger" featuring Jamie Foxx, and Beyoncé's "Formation".
